description: [agencies] For collection agencies receiving placements, or creditors placing accounts with an agency. Answer yes/no/unknown per item (agreement, authority, validation-information fields, scrubs, SOL review, licensing, data security, complaints, remittance). Returns a checklist with primary-source links. Licensing items link to regulators only and never conclude whether a license is required.

account_support.description: Account support available on request (statements, agreements, payment history)

complaints_disputes.description: Complaint and dispute handling process documented

creditor_authority.description: Documented authority from the account owner to place and collect

data_security.description: Information-security program and secure file transfer in place

itemization_data.description: Validation-information fields ready (itemization date, amounts, creditor names)

licensing_confirmed.description: State licensing and bonding confirmed with each regulator (links only; no conclusion here)

placement_agreement.description: Written placement or servicing agreement (scope, fees, remittance, recall rights)

reporting_remittance.description: Reporting, remittance, and reconciliation schedule agreed

scrubs.description: Bankruptcy, deceased, and dispute scrubs completed and documented

name: placement_readiness_check
title: Placement readiness check (agencies and creditors)
